item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Google releases Gemini 4 Neon, its first frontier model in a while: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Neon, which reportedly beats rival models Astra and Fable on LiveBench. It also cut the runtime of one TypeScript-to-Rust benchmark by 48.6%.
Active intrusion campaign targets Check Point security management servers: An active intrusion campaign is targeting Check Point security management servers, a topic that drew strong discussion on Hacker News. Operators of these servers should check their exposure and review their security posture.
Microsoft declares internal 'Code Red' after nearly 24-hour Outlook outage: Microsoft has declared an unusual internal 'Code Red' after an Exchange Online and Outlook outage that lasted almost a day and disrupted email for millions of customers. Internal memos reportedly describe an overhaul and a goal of one-hour recovery.
